study.title: Deep learning-based early weed segmentation using motion blurred UAV images of sorghum fields
study.short_title: Early Weed Segmentation in Sorghum (Motion-Blur UAV)

dataset.name: UAV imagery of experimental sorghum field, Southern Germany (sorghum cv FarmSugar 180)
dataset.note: DJI Mavic 2 Pro Hasselblad L1D-20c (5472x3648); 5 m flight altitude, GSD 1 mm; 60 captures at BBCH 17, ~6300 patches annotated from 19 images, 2156 patches (256x256) after background filtering, 4-fold CV + hold-out test set. Classes: background/soil, sorghum, weed.

F1.quote: An UNet-like architecture with a ResNet-34 feature extractor achieved an F1-score of over 89% on a hold-out test-set.
F1.ambiguity: F1-score 89.37% (macro-averaged, hold-out test set, S/weed/background); the row-extracted table row 99.69/93.01/86.25/89.37 maps DS 0.9969 (background), recall 86.25, F1 89.37.

Dice.ambiguity: Table extraction ambiguous: the single extracted row likely corresponds to the background/soil class DS 99.69% (soil pixels almost perfectly predicted); macro Dice across classes not clearly stated.

PA.ambiguity: Not reported; per-class pixel accuracy 99.9% (soil), 86.1% (sorghum), 72.7% (weed) from confusion matrix.

weed_F1.ambiguity: Only macro metrics and per-class confusion-matrix accuracies reported.

issues: Table 5 extraction captured a single row; DS 99.69 likely background/soil class while macro metrics all above 86%.
